from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionData(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a construction report."""
    data_period: str = Field(description="The month the data applies to, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    permits: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for total building permits")
    starts: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for housing starts")
    completions: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for housing completions")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Date the source report was released (YYYY-MM-DD), used for precedence resolution")
    report_identifier: str = Field(description="Unique press release identifier (e.g., 'CB22-156')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    construction_records: list[MonthlyConstructionData]
